name: Claude Fable 5
description: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 model launched with enhanced coding capabilities, topping the SWE-bench Verified benchmark at 95.0%. Available via Claude API, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry with stronger coding, knowledge work, vision, memory, and long-context performance.
community_quotes: Tops the SWE-bench Verified benchmark at 95.0%
Safer general-use model with stronger coding abilities
One of the best AI models for coding as of June 2026

name: Xcode 27 Beta
description: Apple's Xcode 27 introduces agentic coding with direct integrations of models from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI. Features conversational coding agents, planning with agents as first-class artifacts, and SwiftUI-specific agent skills.
community_quotes: Planning with agents is now first class in Xcode
Xcode 27 takes the next big step in agentic coding
Integrates coding agents from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI directly into development workflow

name: Kimi Code CLI
description: Terminal-based AI coding agent from Moonshot AI that can read/edit code, execute shell commands, search files, fetch web pages, and autonomously decide next actions based on feedback. Features built-in coder, explore, and plan sub-agents.
community_quotes: Kimi Code CLI 是一个运行在终端里的AI 编程agent
Can implement new features, fix bugs, complete refactoring
Integrates with various platforms through MCP (Model Context Protocol) services

name: Microsoft Scout
description: Microsoft's first 'Autopilot' agent announced at Build 2026. An always-on personal AI agent for work built on OpenClaw and WorkIQ frameworks, designed to work continuously and autonomously on behalf of users, connecting to Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
community_quotes: Represents a shift from software you operate to agents that do the work for you
Built on OpenClaw and WorkIQ frameworks
